svg.text: Whole health wellness · sphere · aurora palette · Delta wave audio

g.text: Entry sequence
Sphere surface becomes transparent at aperture point · no hard threshold
Camera passes through membrane · continuous transition outside → inside
Aperture returns to opacity behind camera · shield restored
Audio: 432Hz descends over 3 seconds → Delta wave binaural (0.5–4Hz)
Environment
Interior: warm amber diffused light · no hard shadows · late-afternoon quality
Shell: translucent crystalline with aurora color cycling (blue/green/purple)
Exterior shield visible as faint cyan glow through walls · warm side of barrier
Soft particle motes in warm light · breathing rhythm (5% ambient pulse)
Room-scale enclosure · protective, not restrictive · no data streams
Lighting + atmosphere
Diffused amber fill (soft gold)
Aurora shell: slow organic cycle
No point lights, no hard edges
Breathing-sync ambient pulse
Zero angular geometry inside
Audio signature
2Hz Delta binaural foundation
Warm low-freq pad (breathing)
No interaction tones at all
Unbroken audio blanket
Crisis ack: single soft bell tone
Glass-morphic UI overlay (lightest touch in portal)
Warm amber-tinted frosted glass · gentle parallax (±1.5° max)
Mind: "How are you feeling today?" · invitation, not diagnostic
Body: wellness dashboard · circular progress indicators · soft edges
Spirit: purpose exploration · interconnection pattern · minimal text
Crisis pathway: quiet warm line at bottom · "If you need support, we're here"
Present without presumptuous · visible without alarming · Brandon Act compliant
Return to NOVA (gentlest exit)
Shell becomes transparent · warm light visible from outside briefly
Camera withdraws · shield restores · sanctuary remains
Delta waves crossfade (3s) → 432Hz · amber color cast lingers on camera
You carry the warmth briefly · then the void reasserts

svg.text: Emotional register: safety communicated, not performed
The one scene where the user doesn't have to go anywhere — they just have to be here
